title: Map
description: Your {{type}} on a map, with their state. The list and the map show the same sites; the pins follow the list order.
noMatch: No site matches the search or the filter.
emptyText: Sites with a position appear here as pins.
capped: {{shown}} of {{total}} positions are drawn; the list names all sites.

controls.cooperative: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
controls.cooperativeMac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
controls.cooperativeMobile: Use two fingers to move the map

off.title: The map is off
off.text: Nothing is sent to a map provider. An administrator can turn the map on; until then the list shows every site.

webgl.title: This browser cannot draw the map
webgl.text: The map needs WebGL 2, which this browser or virtual desktop does not offer. The list shows every site.

load.title: The map could not be loaded
load.text: The tile source did not answer. The list shows every site.

picker.label: Map to pick the position
picker.help: Click on the map to set latitude and longitude, or type them above.

widget.notVisible: Not visible: the plant registry is not open to you.

settings.title: Map of sites
settings.description: Shows the sites on a map (Plant → Map, the site page, the dashboard widget). The browser loads everything from Steward; Steward's server fetches the tiles, caches them and never shares your users' addresses.
settings.offNote: The map is off: nothing is sent anywhere. OpenStreetMap is preselected – one click turns it on.

osm.label: OpenStreetMap
osm.privacy: Raster tiles. Steward's server fetches them from tile.openstreetmap.org: the provider sees Steward's address and the areas viewed, never a user's. For light use, as the OpenStreetMap tile usage policy asks.

openfreemap.label: Light and dark (OpenFreeMap)
openfreemap.privacy: Vector tiles that follow the theme. Steward's server fetches them from tiles.openfreemap.org (OpenStreetMap data, no key, no service level).

own.label: Own tile source
own.privacy: A tile URL template or a MapLibre style URL of your own server or provider, optionally with an API key. Steward's server fetches from the origins it names.

file.label: Self-hosted file (PMTiles)
file.privacy: A PMTiles file in Steward's maps folder, raster or vector. Nothing leaves Steward – for networks without internet access.

own.styleHelp: A MapLibre style (style.json). Steward keeps its sources and layers and serves everything through its own address.
own.attributionHelp: The text the provider asks to show, for example “© Example Maps”. Shown on every map.
own.keyHelp: Stored in the vault and added by Steward's server; the browser never sees it.
own.keyStored: A key is stored in the vault. Leave this empty to keep it.
own.keyAgain: The stored key belongs to the previous address: enter it again for this one.
own.checked_one: Read: {{count}} layer, {{kind}}. The origins below are where Steward will fetch from.
own.checked_other: Read: {{count}} layers, {{kind}}. The origins below are where Steward will fetch from.

file.none: No PMTiles file found there yet. Whoever runs Steward places it (for example a regional extract made with pmtiles extract).
file.attributionFrom: The file says: {{text}}. Leave empty to show that.
file.attributionNone: The file names no attribution: enter the one its data needs.

settings.stepUp: Changing where tiles come from asks you to confirm it is you (step-up) and is written to the audit log.
settings.outbound: Map tiles (plant registry): the map's fetcher reaches {{origins}} – for the map only, not for processes.
settings.outboundNone: Map tiles (plant registry): from a file in the data folder – nothing leaves Steward.
